explanation: Sesame pods split open when ripe and scatter their seeds, so farmers cut the plants before the pods burst. Unhulled seeds make a darker, more bitter tahini.

claims.text: Tahini is made by grinding sesame seeds.
Tahini is not made from sunflower, pumpkin or poppy seeds.
Sesame pods split open when ripe and scatter the seeds, so the plants are harvested before the pods burst.
Tahini made from unhulled sesame seeds is darker and more bitter than tahini made from hulled seeds.
